description: Find open public tender and RFP notices that match keywords, CPV codes, and buyer countries, read from four official portals with no key: UK Contracts Finder, UK Find a Tender, EU TED (Tenders Electronic Daily), and CanadaBuys. Returns one row per notice with portal, notice_id, notice_url, title, description_excerpt, buyer_name, buyer_country, published_at, deadline_at, days_to_deadline, estimated_value, currency, category_codes (CPV or UNSPSC), contract_type, procedure, sme_suitable (UK), buyer_contact_email, matched_keywords, and match_source. Filters run before billing. When nothing matches, one free no_results row says why. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per notice row returned plus a run start.

countries.description: Two letter buyer country codes, for example GB, DE, CA. A portal that covers none of them is skipped.

cpv_prefixes.description: Keep notices with a CPV code that starts with one of these, for example 72 or 48000000. CanadaBuys uses UNSPSC codes, so a CPV filter leaves it out.

exclude_keywords.description: Drop a notice whose title or description contains any of these.

keywords.description: Words or phrases to find in the notice title or description, any case. A notice matches any of them. EU TED matches over the full notice text in every language. Empty: every open notice in the window. Up to 25.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before any row that would take its charges over this amount.

max_notices.description: Notice rows per run, newest first, up to 5000. Each notice row is billed. Default 100.

min_value.description: Drop notices valued below this number, in the notice currency. Notices with no value are kept.

only_new.description: Skip notices an earlier run with the same state_key returned. Default false.

only_open.description: Drop notices whose deadline has passed. Default true.

portals.description: Portals to read. Default all four.

published_within_days.description: Publication window in days, 1 to 90, today included. Default 14.

state_key.description: Names the seen list for only_new.

name: find_open_tenders
title: Find open tenders and RFPs
